name: SF JobsNOW!
description: Paid on-the-job training and job placement for San Francisco public benefits recipients
fullDescription: SF JobsNOW! is the San Francisco Human Services Agency's paid employment training program. It matches SFHSA clients receiving public benefits with City jobs and local employers so they can earn money while gaining work experience.
whatTheyOffer:
- Public Service Trainee (PST) Program: temporary, paid training with the City and County of San Francisco (six months, possibly extended three to six months)
- On-Site Training Program: six months of paid, on-the-job training with private and nonprofit employers
- Help with career exploration, resumes, job applications, and interviews
- Digital skills support
- A program liaison to support you once hired
howToGetIt:
1. Must be authorized to work in the U.S.
2. Must receive public benefits through SFHSA, such as CalWORKs, CalFresh, or CAAP
3. Talk to your case worker or visit an SFHSA Employment Information Center
4. Get matched with a JobsNOW! opportunity
keywords: SF JobsNOW, San Francisco, SFHSA, paid job training, wage subsidy, Public Service Trainee, On-Site Training, CalWORKs, CalFresh, CAAP, job search, employment program
